title: Streaming World-Sections -- bounded-memory stitched Fiedler at galactic scale
gate_source: EXP-506 sectioning validated -> stream sections under a resident-set memory bound

method.streamability: each leaf's stitched value depends only on the coarse field c and section centroids (both O(S)), never on other sections' leaves
method.pass1: accumulate section edge counts -> Galerkin coarse Fiedler c + centroids; computed ONCE (global anchor)
method.pass2: stream sections, <= max_resident resident; per-section local lambda_2 -> halo sigma_s; emit stitched leaf values
method.cache: per-section local Fiedler content-addressed by section signature -> revisits hit cache
method.eviction: LRU eviction keeps the resident set bounded; memory = peak_resident + coarse O(S)
method.bound: peak resident = max_resident * max_section_size + O(S) << O(N)

assertions_fork_A: [3] bounded working set: peak_resident_leaves < N (== max section size at max_resident=1)
[4] eviction: resident set never exceeds max_resident sections
[5] coarse anchor O(S) computed once (the global fault)
[6] content-addressed cache: section revisits hit cache (cache_hits >= n_sections)
[7] memory bound: streaming << global at scale (peak_resident + O(S))
[9] fault preserved: streaming field reproduces the global fault structure (via EXP-506 stitch)
[10] decoupled: game/ has no engine.* import (clean-room guard)

exp508plus_gate.trigger: streaming validated -> multi-velocity tracking (moving sections) + live SSE deployment
exp508plus_gate.target: per-section velocity prediction (NN association) for non-rigid motion at scale
